messages:
maya: Quick sync — we plan to ship hotpath routing (model: rwd/hot-1) next week. I want a compact rollout plan: canaries, slice sizes, telemetry gates, fallback policy, tenant opt-outs. My initial thought: NA -> EU -> APAC, internal 1% -> beta 5% -> ramp. 48h bake per phase. Any objections or must-haves?

sam: +1 on phased ramp. Couple engineering notes: prefer two micro-canaries: 0.5% internal (dogfood) then 2% internal (autoclosed) before public 5%. We need an auto-circuit-breaker with clear thresholds: p95 latency > 200ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1% -> immediate fallback. Also we should disable KV cache warming for first canary to avoid state skew.

priya: Telemetry specifics: track p50/p95/p99 latency, 5m rolling error rate, token-cost delta vs baseline, and prompt-quality score (daily eval set). Add per-tenant anomaly alerting w/ rolling 1h and 24h baselines. Pager thresholds: p95>250ms or token-cost increase >20% for 1h -> paged oncall. Non-pager alert for smaller blips.

leo: Fallback routing: on circuit-breaker, route to rwd/default-quant (cheaper quantized variant) in same region. If capacity constraint, route to hosted-fallback in a different region per routing policy. Important: maintain session stickiness for conversational sessions; ensure KV cache flush/transfer is handled or degrade gracefully. Also add a manual kill-switch in Console for immediate cutover.

aaron: Ops/customer ask: need an opt-out API + Console toggle per-tenant for customers who require strict stability. Also prepare a customer-facing note (1 pager) that explains potential transient QoS changes during ramp and how to opt-out. For enterprise customers with dedicated capacity, coordinate a separate rollout schedule.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: 2026-03-28 02:00 UTC -> 03:30 UTC (canary window). CI pipeline will run smoke tests against dogfood canary. Tag: hotpath-v1-canary.

maya: Nice — short action list so we can close: 1) sam -> implement circuit-breaker + flag rollout (hotpath_v1) and micro-canary flow (owner: sam) 2) priya -> telemetry dashboard + pager thresholds + eval set (owner: priya) 3) leo -> fallback routing chains + session stickiness doc (owner: leo) 4) aaron -> opt-out UI + customer comms (owner: aaron) 5) eng-platform -> finalize deploy window (deploy-bot tagged). Please reply with "ack" when you've claimed the item. We'll plan a 15m preflight 30m before the window. :thumbsup:
